post.description: CRS-0053: *"Same kind of job will be split into several jobs"* � three faults at one address became three RFQs, three quotes and three visits. The case named in the path is ABSORBED: its description is appended to the target under an attributed "Also reported" heading, its intake photos are carried across, the durable `duplicateOfId` link is written, and it is then closed as a duplicate through the ordinary manual-close writer (so the tenant email, the audit line and `closureReason` behave exactly as any close). The target is written BEFORE the source is closed: a failed close leaves the fault recorded twice, which is visible and fixable, whereas the other order would delete a report the tenant filed. Intake already flags likely duplicates and tells the officer to "merge or dismiss" � this is the merge. Combining is never automatic: a case is the unit of quote, approval, responsibility and SLA clock, and folding a second fault into an approved one would make the approved figure cover work nobody quoted.

post.description: Daniel §6.2 / AC-04..06: an urgent job (priority critical/high) pauses automation and is raised to the Account Manager. No urgent/emergency work order may be issued without an ACTIVE authorisation. CONFIRM_URGENT / EMERGENCY_MAKE_SAFE require a contractor, a scope and a spending limit greater than zero (there is no silent default); the make-safe order authorises only the safety measure. CONVERT_TO_NORMAL / ESCALATE_EXTERNAL / CLOSE_NO_ACTION require a reason. A re-authorisation appends a new row and supersedes the previous one; the record is never overwritten. Returns the workflow bundle plus the refreshed V2 slice.

finalValue.description: Shape differs per action; validated by the action’s own resume handler.

modules.description: AiModuleKey lanes and/or 'global'. Must name at least one.

documentPath.description: Relative API path to download the agreement document.

portalServiceLevel.description: Omitted means Self-Manage (free). Inspection Only and Full Service are optional paid plans. Legacy cannot be chosen at signup.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true — agent accepts the CROSSUB terms and conditions.

seen.description: Guide id -> completion status for this user.

currentPassword.description: Required unless the account was created via a sales registration invite (mustChangePasswordWithoutCurrent).

token.description: Raw token from the verification email link

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file contents.

signerName.description: Full legal name of the signer.

agreed.description: Must be true — confirms the user has read and agrees to the agreement.

portal.description: When `inspector`, accept the INSPECTOR portal clickwrap (name-only). Required for dual-hat staff using the inspector app; admin portal omits this and uses the role agreement.

firstName.description: Required for staff/admin portal roles before access. Updates the user profile.

fullName.description: Full legal name for the HR employee record (staff agreement).

country.description: Location of work for the agreement (staff agreement).

monthlySalaryCurrency.description: Currency for monthly salary (staff agreement). Defaults to AUD.

wiseBankAccountNumber.description: Wise bank account number for payroll payouts (staff agreement).

identificationDocument.description: Exactly one identification document (Passport / Driver Licence / National ID Card).

addressVerificationDocument.description: Exactly one address verification document (Utility Bill / Bank Statement / Government Letter).

educationDocuments.description: Optional education document uploads (Degree / Diploma / Certificates).

employmentDocuments.description: Optional employment document uploads (Resume / Employment Contract / NDA / Other).

confirmDuplicate.description: Proceed even though an agency with the same name or principal email already exists. Send only after showing the operator which agency was matched.

sendPortalCredentials.description: When true, email a temporary password to the contact. When false, return it once in the response.

officeAddress.description: Agent office location for this agency membership.

membershipTier.description: PRINCIPAL for agency director login; AGENT for field agent (default).

primaryContactUserId.description: Portal agent user id. Null keeps the agency (company) as the primary contact.

billingContactUserId.description: Portal agent user id who pays the monthly invoice. Null leaves billing with the principal.

slug.description: Local part of `{slug}@email.crossub.com.au`: lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, 2–48 characters, not a reserved mailbox name. Trimmed and lowercased server-side.

folio.description: CROSSUB = managed under CROSSUB's folio (internal officers see its conversations); EXTERNAL = the agency's own folio (only the agency's users see them).

contractorId.description: Verified-network contractor id (c1–c8) when picking from the catalogue.

email.description: The RFQ is delivered by email — a contractor saved without one cannot be sent a quote request.

location.description: Free text as typed. Not geocoded.

profileImageUrl.description: Small avatar as a `data:` URL. Downscale before sending — oversized images are rejected rather than stored, because this column is read back on every list load.

serviceTypes.description: Drives which jobs this contractor is pre-selected for.
